# Ametherian

> Ametherian is a proposed family of modular JavaScript and TypeScript libraries under the @foulfoxhacks npm scope, with a Node.js-first direction.

The project is at the public proposal and planning stage. Proposed packages and capabilities are not implemented, audited, or production-ready unless a page explicitly says otherwise.

## Project resources

- [Repository](https://github.com/foulfoxhacks/Ametherian-NodeJS)
- [Project status](PROJECT_STATUS.md)
